title: The Sixth Hour
provenance: Traditional received English, in the forms in common liturgical use and long out of copyright. NOT transcribed from any modern published prayer book — those translations are copyrighted. Confirm with Father that these match what the parish actually says.

blocks.text: Appointed for at midday. Five minutes, and unchanging — the easiest of all the hours to keep.

blocks.en: O Thou who on the sixth day and hour didst nail to the Cross the sin which rebellious Adam committed in Paradise: tear asunder also the bond of our iniquities, O Christ our God, and save us.
O Jesus, who art Salvation itself, save us. Not for our works, but for Thy compassion alone, deliver us from the enemy who wars against us, and save Thy people, O Lord.

O Thou who at all times and at every hour, in heaven and on earth, art worshipped and glorified, O Christ our God, who art long-suffering and plenteous in mercy and compassion; who lovest the just and showest mercy upon the sinner: do Thou Thyself, O Master, receive our prayers at this present hour, and direct our lives according to Thy commandments.
Through the prayers of our holy fathers, O Lord Jesus Christ our God, have mercy on us and save us. Amen.
